Acceptable Use Policy User Access Policy Visit METROFOOD-IT Catalogues About METROFOOD-RI METROFOOD-RI is a European research infrastructure for metrology in food and nutrition, supporting quality, safety, traceability and sustainability across the agrifood sector. Included on the ESFRI Roadmap since 2018, it brings together 13+ partner countries and over €17.79M in funding. The infrastructure provides one entry point to reference-material databases, service catalogues and research resources, integrating analytical laboratories and data with the EOSC ecosystem to enable interoperable, FAIR food data access and cross-disciplinary research. Mission To promote metrology in food and nutrition, enhancing food quality and safety across Europe through open access, FAIR data principles, and the digitalisation of agrifood systems. Target Groups Researchers and laboratories needing reference materials and metrological data for food quality and safety. National nodes and partner institutions integrating services into the METROFOOD-RI network. Policymakers requiring evidence-based data on food quality, safety and traceability. EOSC participants exploring METROFOOD-RI services and resources through the EOSC portal. Key Functionalities Reference-material search and cross-search by matrix–analyte combination (RM-App). EOSC-integrated service catalogues. National-node catalogues (e.g. METROFOOD-IT). Membership and partner-onboarding portal. Open, FAIR-compliant data access. Responsible Organisations ENEA — Italian National Agency for New Technologies, Energy and Sustainable Economic Development METROFOOD-RI coordinator (Casaccia Research Centre, Rome, IT) METROFOOD-RI partner institutions National nodes contributing services and resources to the node Case study Metabolomic Analysis of Food Products via Federated METROFOOD-RI Services Exchange Services AAI Service Catalogue Marketplace / Resource Discovery Hub METROFOOD-RI Data Catalogue METROFOOD-RI Helpdesk EGI Cloud Compute User profile A food chemist at an European Research Institution, wants to perform metabolomic analysis of food products to evaluate freshness, flavor, and environmental influences on quality. Problem or Need The researcher needs to identify key metabolic markers, assess nutrient variations, and detect potential contaminants in food samples — however this requires specialised datasets and compute power that their home institution cannot provide. Solution The researcher searches the federated Resource Discovery Hub and finds the relevant METROFOOD-RI services and datasets. They authenticate via EOSC AAI to access the METROFOOD-RI Data Catalogue and submit an access request through the METROFOOD-RI Helpdesk. They then locate and request access to EGI Cloud Compute through the same federated hub, using EOSC AAI, and run their metabolic analyses on the provisioned compute resources, saving the results. Results / Benefits The researcher identifies key metabolic markers, assesses nutrient variations, and detects potential contaminants, without needing to invest in local infrastructure. Data access, authentication and compute provisioning are streamlined end-to-end through federated discovery and single sign-on. EOSC Beyond EOSC Beyond is a European project advancing the implementation of the European Open Science Cloud by connecting research infrastructures as federated Pilot Nodes. METROFOOD-RI participates as a Pilot Node, integrating its digital ecosystem, including the RM-App reference-material search, EOSC Catalogues and national-node catalogues, into the EOSC ecosystem to enable federated discovery, machine-actionable access, and cross-infrastructure support for food and nutrition research. METROFOOD-RI on EOSC Beyond ↗ FAQ & Support Helpdesk Questions about METROFOOD-RI resources, access requests or technical problems? Contact the node helpdesk. premotec-helpdesk@scc.kit.edu How can I access METROFOOD-RI resources in EOSC? Do I need an account to access and use the services? Who can I contact for technical support? Under which policies can I use METROFOOD-RI resources?
